module_summary: PS/2 message framer: a four-state Moore FSM discards bytes until in[3]=1, counts three bytes, and asserts done after the third.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Byte-position FSM register (BYTE1/BYTE2/BYTE3/DONE); sequences message framing and decodes done.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Message-received output, decoded from the DONE state.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Incoming byte stream; only bit 3 is examined for framing.

anchors.name: in3
anchors.why: in[3] start-of-message marker that steers BYTE1/DONE transitions.

groups.name: framing_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic and state register searching for in[3]=1 and counting three bytes.
